```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Treasury Department and the IRS are making it easier and cheaper for Americans to file their taxes and collect refunds they are owed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The IRS successfully piloted a free, easy-to-use online tool, Direct File, which has saved taxpayers millions of dollars in filing fees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct File will be a permanent offering, saving users an average $150 in filing costs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans keep trying to defund Direct File.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden's plans will cut taxes for middle-class and low-income Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Those tax cuts will be financed by making the ultra-wealthy and big corporations pay their fair share.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"There are a thousand billionaires in America, and they pay an average 8 percent in taxes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A firefighter or teacher pays a higher tax rate than billionaires.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make billionaires pay a minimum income tax rate of 25 percent, raising $500 billion in 10 years.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will end preferential treatment for capital gains for millionaires, so they pay the same rate on investment income as on wages.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
